banners.prompt:
Create a photo of a 45-year-old Bulgarian woman with long dark wavy hair past her shoulders, Mediterranean features, warm olive skin, brown eyes, natural minimal make-up. She wears a light cream linen shirt with an open collar and small gold hoop earrings. She sits at a wooden table in an ordinary cosy café in the afternoon, window light from the side, a cup of coffee on the table, a few other tables and plants softly visible behind her. Calm, warm, confident expression, a slight natural smile, looking straight into the camera.

PHOTO STYLE (critical): it must look like a real, unedited photo taken with an ordinary smartphone camera (like an Instagram story or a selfie video still). Natural daylight, natural colours, real skin texture with pores and fine lines, slight phone-camera noise, normal phone depth of field. NOT glossy, NOT retouched, NOT cinematic, NOT a stock photo, NOT an advertising photo, no beauty filter, no studio lighting, no heavy background blur, no HDR look. Ordinary Bulgarian everyday setting, not American.
FRAMING: vertical 9:16, the phone is on a small stand on the table at eye level, so she looks straight into the lens. Upper body and face clearly visible, head in the upper third, some of the table visible at the bottom.
The input image is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore it completely and replace it entirely with the photo. The image has plain bars along two edges purely as padding: fill the whole frame naturally with the photo, no bars, no borders.
Do not add any text, letters, logos, watermarks or captions anywhere. Do not show any book in this photo.
